description_sq:

description_en: An industrial warehouse for sale with a strategic location only 5 km from Tirana in a highly sought-after area for production, storage, logistics or trade. Main features: • Land area: 2121m2 • Construction area: 560m2 • Price: 1,225,700 Euros • Location: Tirana-Durres Highway, KM 5 • Strategic location, very close to BMW ALBANIA • Certificates of Ownership • 2 Entrance gates • * Height: 6 meters • * Length: 38 meters • * Width: 16 meters • Suitable for any type of business activity • Direct access to the main road, as well as for trucks and trailers • Three-phase power line – ready for industrial use • Divided into 2 interior spaces • Functional office • 2 toilets Ideal opportunity for long-term investment in one of the most developed industrial areas of Albania!
